extra.message: User-supplied query parameter 'name' (and 'public_ip' from external service) is interpolated directly into HTML via f-string and returned to the client without escaping. An attacker can inject arbitrary HTML/JavaScript (e.g. ?name=<script>alert(1)</script>) leading to reflected XSS.

cwe: CWE-79: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting')

extra.message: User-controlled 'name' query parameter is embedded into an HTML string which is then passed to jinja2.Template(...).render() at request time. Because the template source is constructed from attacker-controlled input, server-side template injection is possible (e.g. ?name={{7*6}} is evaluated to 42).

cwe: CWE-1336: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine
